featured.title: Global heating will hit at least 1.8C, UN warns, and there are ‘no good outcomes’
featured.summary: But scientists say the world could get back to 1.5C through deep, rapid emissions cuts and removing carbon from the atmosphere Global heating will reach at least 1.8C under even the most optimistic future, well beyond the Paris agreement goal of 1.5C, according to a UN report that warns every fraction of temperature rise intensifies destructive extreme weather, glacier melt, ecosystem loss, and island and coastal city submersion. The report by the Nairobi-based UN Environment Programme confirmed overshooting the 1.5C goal inscribed in the landmark Paris agreement of 2015 was now “unavoidable” and, despite some progress in addressing the human-caused climate crisis driven by burning fossil fuels, likely in the next few years. featured.titleZh: 联合国警告全球变暖将至少达到1.8摄氏度，且“没有好的结果”
featured.summaryZh: 联合国环境规划署报告指出，即使在最乐观的情况下，全球变暖也将至少达到1.8摄氏度，超过了《巴黎协定》设定的1.5摄氏度目标。气温的每一分上升都将加剧极端天气、冰川融化及生态系统损失。
featured.whyImportant: 该报告确认了实现气候目标面临的严峻挑战，并强调了全球气候危机的紧迫性。

The assessment was made in the ministry’s “2026 China Military Power Report”, which was submitted to the legislature this week along with its five-year force development plan and next year’s proposed defence budget. The report said recent PLA exercises were increasingly focused on the “joint...
watch.titleZh: 报告称中国大陆正加强对台封锁准备
watch.summaryZh: 台湾防务部门在年度报告中指出，解放军正加强对台封锁的演练。台湾方面表示已制定相应计划以应对此类封锁威胁。
watch.whyImportant: 台海局势的军事化趋势加剧，增加了地区发生意外冲突的风险。

items.title: Global heating will hit at least 1.8C, UN warns, and there are ‘no good outcomes’
items.summary: But scientists say the world could get back to 1.5C through deep, rapid emissions cuts and removing carbon from the atmosphere Global heating will reach at least 1.8C under even the most optimistic future, well beyond the Paris agreement goal of 1.5C, according to a UN report that warns every fraction of temperature rise intensifies destructive extreme weather, glacier melt, ecosystem loss, and island and coastal city submersion. The report by the Nairobi-based UN Environment Programme confirmed overshooting the 1.5C goal inscribed in the landmark Paris agreement of 2015 was now “unavoidable” and, despite some progress in addressing the human-caused climate crisis driven by burning fossil fuels, likely in the next few years. tags: 专题·气候、环境与公共安全
items.titleZh: 联合国警告全球变暖将至少达到1.8摄氏度，且“没有好的结果”
items.summaryZh: 联合国环境规划署报告指出，即使在最乐观的情况下，全球变暖也将至少达到1.8摄氏度，超过了《巴黎协定》设定的1.5摄氏度目标。气温的每一分上升都将加剧极端天气、冰川融化及生态系统损失。
items.whyImportant: 该报告确认了实现气候目标面临的严峻挑战，并强调了全球气候危机的紧迫性。

items.title: Netanyahu accuses security officials of intentionally not waking him on October 7
items.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused security officials on Tuesday of intentionally failing to wake him on the morning of Hamas’ October 7 attacks, a day after his wife claimed an opposition figure knew of the onslaught in advance. Netanyahu is heading into close-fought elections later this year, and has come in for sustained criticism in the national debate over who is responsible for the failures that led to the October 7, 2023 security fiasco. The prime minister has alleged in...
items.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡指责安全官员在10月7日故意未叫醒他
items.summaryZh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡指责安全官员在哈马斯发动10月7日袭击当天故意未叫醒他。随着选举临近，内塔尼亚胡正面临关于谁应为安全失败负责的持续批评。
items.whyImportant: 此言论加剧了以色列国内关于安全部门失职责任的政治争端。

items.summaryZh: 在取消对丹尼尔·安德鲁斯的致敬活动后，维多利亚州州长批评了为州领导人立像的行为。此外，一名网约车司机因涉嫌在悉尼CBD进行性犯罪而面临指控。
items.whyImportant: 这些事件反映了澳大利亚在公共纪念政策及社会治安问题上的争议。

items.title: What to know about Germany’s drone attack accusations against Russia
items.summary: German intelligence has concluded that an explosive-laden drone was linked to Russia. Officials promise consequences.
items.titleZh: 关于德国指控俄罗斯发动无人机袭击你需要了解什么
items.summaryZh: 德国情报部门已得出结论，认为一起爆炸性无人机袭击与俄罗斯有关。德国官员承诺将采取后续行动。
items.whyImportant: 此指控可能导致德国与俄罗斯之间的外交关系进一步恶化。

items.summaryZh: 伊朗官员表示，美国对库赫斯塔克市的袭击造成包括妇女和儿童在内的至少63人受伤。目前已有五人在袭击中丧生。
items.whyImportant: 该事件可能导致中东地区紧张局势进一步升级。

items.title: Japan’s deadliest delicacy is getting more dangerous
items.summary: Japan’s most dangerous delicacy is getting harder to prepare safely as warming seas push different pufferfish species into the same waters, where they are inbreeding to produce hybrids whose lethal toxins are not yet fully understood. Fugu – the collective Japanese name for several species of edible pufferfish – is prized as much for the danger surrounding its preparation as for its subtle flavour. Many species contain tetrodotoxin, a powerful neurotoxin with no known antidote that can cause...
items.titleZh: 日本最致命的美味正变得越来越危险
items.summaryZh: 由于海水变暖，不同种类的河豚在同一水域杂交，产生了毒性尚不明确的后代。这种被称为“河豚”的传统美食因其潜在的致命神经毒素而变得更加难以安全处理。
items.whyImportant: 气候变化对海洋生态的影响正直接威胁到传统的食品安全标准。

items.title: US launches new strikes on Iran, denies its bases hit in Jordan
items.summary: The US launched new strikes on Iran's southern coast with explosions reported in several locations.
items.titleZh: 美国对伊朗发动新一轮袭击，否认其在约旦的基地遭到打击
items.summaryZh: 美国对伊朗南部海岸发动了新一轮袭击，多个地点报告发生了爆炸。美方否认了关于其在约旦的基地受到攻击的说法。
items.whyImportant: 美伊之间的直接军事对抗升级引发了对地区冲突扩大的担忧。

items.title: Federal judge tosses Trump lawsuit over young trans athletes in California school sports
items.summary: In a major LGBTQ+ rights victory, the justice department cannot force the state to ban trans girls from women’s sports A federal judge has dismissed the Trump administration’s lawsuit challenging California’s policy of allowing transgender youth to play on sports teams that match their gender, a major loss for Donald Trump and the Department of Justice (DoJ). The justice department had been fighting for a year to force California to ban trans girls from women’s sports, with the president directly singling out one trans track and field athlete in online attacks and regularly mocking trans athletes in his speeches. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 联邦法官驳回特朗普针对加州学校跨性别运动员的诉讼
items.summaryZh: 联邦法官驳回了特朗普政府试图强制加州禁止跨性别女孩参加女子体育比赛的诉讼。这一裁决被视为LGBTQ+权利的一项重大胜利。
items.whyImportant: 该裁决限制了联邦政府干预州级跨性别运动员政策的权力，具有重要的法律先例意义。

items.title: Enflame’s US$900m IPO tests appetite for China’s ‘little dragon’ AI chipmakers
items.summary: As Enflame Technology gears up for a 6.12 billion yuan (US$910.3 million) initial public offering on Shanghai’s Star Market, the Chinese artificial intelligence chipmaker must convince investors that its specialised chip strategy can withstand fierce competition from Huawei Technologies and other domestic rivals, while reducing its heavy revenue dependence on major backer Tencent Holdings. items.titleZh: 燧原科技9亿美元IPO测试市场对中国“小龙”AI芯片制造商的胃口
items.summaryZh: 中国AI芯片制造商燧原科技正准备在上海科创板进行61.2亿元人民币的首次公开募股。该公司需向投资者证明其专业芯片策略能应对华为等国内竞争对手的激烈竞争，并减少对主要支持者腾讯的营收依赖。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了中国AI芯片企业在资本市场寻求融资以应对激烈行业竞争的现状。

items.title: More than a third of prenatal reports to NSW protective services not investigated, ombudsman finds
items.summary: Other families have been unlawfully compelled to be case-managed without consent, watchdog finds Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast More than a third of all reports raising concerns about the future welfare of unborn children were closed due to a shortage of allocated caseworkers, while families were unlawfully compelled to take part in prenatal case work, the New South Wales ombudsman has found. In its findings after investigating the Department of Communities and Justice’s practice of responding to prenatal reports, which were released on Friday, the watchdog raised concerns about the number of reports about particularly high-risk children that were not referred on to further support services or a dedicated case manager due to a lack of resources. items.titleZh: 新南威尔士州监察员发现：超过三分之一的产前保护服务报告未获调查
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州监察员调查发现，由于个案管理人员短缺，超过三分之一涉及未出生婴儿福利的报告被搁置。此外，一些家庭在未经同意的情况下被非法强制进行产前个案管理。
items.whyImportant: 该调查揭露了公共福利部门在资源分配和程序合规性方面的严重管理漏洞。

items.title: China’s 2026 moon laser communication speed is slower than Nasa’s in 2013
items.summary: China has pulled off two-way laser communication between Earth and the moon, making it only the second nation after the United States to do so. But the data rates it achieved were well behind those recorded by Nasa more than a decade ago, and that has left space experts scratching their heads. Using telescopes in Yunnan province and an experimental satellite that is now orbiting the moon after a launch mishap in 2024, the team recorded a downlink speed of 100 megabits per second and an uplink...
items.titleZh: 中国2026年月球激光通信速度慢于美国2013年水平
items.summaryZh: 中国实现了地月之间的双向激光通信，成为继美国之后第二个掌握此技术的国家。然而，其数据传输速率远低于美国十多年前的记录，引发了空间专家的关注。
items.whyImportant: 这一技术差距引发了外界对中国在深空通信领域实际技术水平的讨论。

items.title: Higher typhoon signal possible, depending on Saudel’s course after rare resurgence
items.summary: Hong Kong’s weather forecaster may issue a higher typhoon signal closer to the weekend after Tropical Cyclone Saudel experienced a rare resurgence and could change its course over the South China Sea, edging towards the Pearl River Delta. items.titleZh: 台风“沙德尔”罕见回旋，香港或将提升台风信号
items.summaryZh: 受台风“沙德尔”罕见回旋并可能改变路径影响，香港天文台表示周末可能需要提升台风信号。目前一号戒备信号维持，受台风与东北季候风共同影响，离岸风力偶尔强劲。
items.whyImportant: 台风路径的不确定性对香港及珠三角地区的交通与市民生活构成潜在威胁。

items.title: Joshua Wong admits instigating sanctions against Beijing, Hong Kong governments
items.summary: Jailed Hong Kong opposition activist Joshua Wong Chi-fung has admitted instigating international sanctions against central and local authorities six years ago, such as urging foreign businesses to avoid investment in mainland China and petitioning an Israeli forensic tech firm to terminate its services for the city’s police force. The High Court heard on Wednesday that Wong, 29, had conspired with fugitive ex-lawmaker Nathan Law Kwun-chung, 33, and others to garner international support for...
items.titleZh: 黄之锋承认煽动对北京及香港政府实施制裁
items.summaryZh: 香港在囚反对派人士黄之锋在高等法院承认，曾于六年前串谋他人煽动国际社会对中国中央及香港政府实施制裁。其行为包括游说外国企业撤资及要求以色列科技公司停止向香港警方提供服务。
items.whyImportant: 此案是香港国安法相关司法程序的重要进展，涉及对过往政治行为的法律定性。

items.title: Tanker, transporter, controller: China’s Y-20 family expands its Pacific reach
items.summary: When six Chinese heavy transport planes entered European airspace in April 2022, it was not just their cargo that drew international attention. Bound for Serbia, the Y-20 aircraft had flown thousands of kilometres from China carrying components of the Chinese-made FK-3 surface-to-air missile system. items.titleZh: 加油机、运输机、指挥机：中国运-20机队扩大其太平洋影响力
items.summaryZh: 中国运-20大型运输机队近年来频繁执行远程任务，包括向欧洲运送导弹系统组件。随着该机型衍生出加油机和指挥机等变体，其战略投送能力和海外影响力显著增强。
items.whyImportant: 运-20机队的扩展标志着中国空军远程战略投送能力的显著提升。

items.title: Welfare groups seek clarity on breed classification amid third fighting dog case
items.summary: A Hong Kong man has surrendered his dog after authorities detained it and classified it as a fighting breed – the third known case in a week following a spate of attacks in the city. The case came as animal welfare groups called for clarity on the government’s breed-classification procedures and a transparent appeal mechanism. They warned that heightened anxiety could lead to more pet abandonment and unfair stereotyping of certain breeds. Jacqueline Cheung, founder of the non-profit Love Adopt...
items.titleZh: 香港发生第三起斗牛犬伤人事件，动物福利团体寻求品种分类标准明确化
items.summaryZh: 香港近期发生多起犬只伤人事件，当局已将涉事犬只归类为斗牛犬种。动物福利团体呼吁政府明确品种分类程序及上诉机制，以防引发恐慌导致弃养潮。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对于城市宠物管理政策及动物福利保护平衡点的讨论。

items.title: Ukraine’s president warns airlines to avoid ‘drone-infested’ Russian airspace

items.titleZh: 乌克兰总统警告航空公司避开“无人机出没”的俄罗斯领空
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基警告称，乌方无人机将使俄罗斯领空在战争期间变得“极度不安全”。此言论遭到俄罗斯总统普京的强烈谴责，称其为“国家恐怖主义”。
items.whyImportant: 俄乌冲突的升级已直接威胁到民用航空安全，加剧了地缘政治紧张局势。

items.title: Iran war live: Tehran claims attacks on US bases in Bahrain, Jordan, Iraq
items.summary: Tehran pledges 'severe punishment' and retaliation against Washington following a new wave of US attacks.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：德黑兰声称袭击了美国在巴林、约旦和伊拉克的基地

items.whyImportant: 此举标志着中东地区冲突的显著升级，可能导致美国与伊朗之间爆发更广泛的军事对抗。

items.title: Trump envoy Daines visits Chinese AI, space firms to pave way for Xi summit in US
items.summary: US Senator Steve Daines, a close ally of President Donald Trump, has wrapped up a days-long trip to China, just weeks ahead of Chinese leader Xi Jinping’s planned visit to Washington. items.titleZh: 特朗普特使戴恩斯访问中国人工智能和航天企业，为习近平访美铺路
items.summaryZh: 美国参议员史蒂夫·戴恩斯在习近平主席计划访美前夕结束了对中国的访问。他走访了杭州和广州的科技中心，旨在为两国领导人的会晤进行前期沟通。
items.whyImportant: 此次访问显示出美中双方在紧张局势下仍试图通过外交渠道保持沟通，为高层会晤创造条件。

items.title: Mark Carney tells US to ‘start being serious’ amid escalating trade war
items.summary: Canadian PM is set to retaliate against tariffs levied by Donald Trump and criticized US officials over insults US politics live – latest updates Mark Carney has rebuked Donald Trump’s administration and urged officials in Washington to “start being serious” amid escalating trade tensions between the US and Canada. Days before Canada is due to retaliate against Trump’s sweeping tariffs with its own duties on US goods, the Canadian prime minister criticized US officials for insulting his country. “It is beneath their office,” he said. items.titleZh: 马克·卡尼在贸易战升级背景下要求美国“开始认真对待”

items.whyImportant: 美加贸易摩擦的加剧可能对北美经济一体化造成深远影响，并进一步恶化两国的政治关系。

items.title: Apple changes name of Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’ in maps app
items.summary: The change marks the second US-based tech giant to comply with President Donald Trump's controversial order.
items.titleZh: 苹果公司在地图应用中将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”
items.summaryZh: 此举使苹果成为第二家遵守特朗普总统争议性行政命令的美国科技巨头。该更名行为引发了关于企业服从政府指令与地理事实之间冲突的讨论。

items.title: US urges G20 to cut trade imbalances, focus on China
items.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent urges other G20 countries to do more to protect their economies from Chinese imports.

items.summaryZh: 美国财政部长贝森特呼吁G20成员国采取更多措施，以保护本国经济免受中国进口商品的影响。美方试图在多边框架下协调对华贸易立场。

items.title: Russia targets Ukraine’s rail network as war enters deadly new phase

items.titleZh: 俄乌战争进入致命新阶段，俄罗斯瞄准乌克兰铁路网
